scope: JSON and numeric evidence audit only; no arithmetic benchmark, build, test or production edit performed by this subtask.
integer_handling: JSON number tokens that are integers outside +/- (2^53-1) were preserved as decimal strings before JSON.parse. Timestamp differences and chronology were evaluated with BigInt. Unix-nanosecond timestamps are emitted as decimal strings in this audit, never rounded doubles.

recipe_binding.external_binding: Exact corpus recipe is bound here to frozen driver source SHA256 face3bc7aeaa43c2a10365bd80f7b19ccc143d668da00a59f6eece12d6f50d14; recipe, x0, full/prefix hashes and native all-input preservation receipts agree across both raw series.

interpretation.N: RHS operands; x0 is included once globally.
interpretation.cells: ns_sum and ns_rhs summarize raw elapsed_ns/jobs and elapsed_ns/(jobs*N), respectively. Means and min/median/max are normalized region means, not individual-call latency quantiles.
interpretation.ratios: Each ratio is the same-round numerator region-mean ns/sum divided by denominator region-mean ns/sum. >1 favors denominator; <1 favors numerator. Median is over all eight paired ratios, not a ratio of separate medians.
interpretation.wins: Strict comparison to 1; no tie epsilon. Each stored comparison has eight pairs. Raw round-by-round evidence remains in immutable raw files bound by SHA256; posthoc comparisons are recomputable from those raw regions.
interpretation.preregistered: Each series.preregistered_FE64_baseline contains six preregistered candidates versus FE64 at each of six sizes.
interpretation.posthoc: Each series.posthoc_internal contains all ten unordered pairs of five E2E schedules at each size, plus E2E weak4095 versus resident weak4095. These 132 cross-series comparison summaries were requested after inspection of S1 and are exploratory, not preregistered selection criteria.
interpretation.setup: Route 6 excludes resident RHS preconversion and uses 40-byte elements. Routes 0..5 accept FE64 inputs; E2E FE52 routes pack RHS inside the timed sum. Any comparison involving route 6 crosses setup contracts.
interpretation.threshold_coverage: Both processes completed and all cells qualified through two >=200ms calibration records at the same job count. This does NOT mean every later record met 200ms: S2 cell2 has one short warmup and eight short measurement records, retained in all summaries and ratios.
interpretation.threshold_positive_scope: All warmup and measurement records with N>=16 meet 200ms in both series.
interpretation.cpu: Every recorded sched_getcpu and per-region power-snapshot CPU endpoint equals 4; endpoints do not prove absence of migration or yield time-average frequency.
interpretation.security_and_novelty: No CT certification, secret-dependent dispatch, new-mathematics, world-record, scalar or upper-layer gain claim.
limits: Persisted expected and actual final bytes/checksums were independently compared; this is not a new Boost arithmetic-oracle run.
Full corpus recipe/hash equality and native preservation receipts were checked; one million inputs were not regenerated in JavaScript.
All short records and all eight paired samples remain included; no selective rerun or removal.
No memory-bandwidth/cache or register-pressure causality is inferred from times, layout sizes or internal schedule differences.
Resident setup observation is descriptive, not an amortization break-even benchmark.
Source/binary codegen and mechanical test qualification are manager-owned evidence outside this numerical audit.

cross_series.corpus_evidence: Exact recipe/x0/full and prefix hash equality plus native per-run all-word preservation receipts; audit does not rerun field arithmetic or reconstruct one million RHS values in JavaScript.

corpus.recipe: SplitMix64 state=seed xor0x6669656c645f7033; four successive words encoded BE to32bytes; strict parse rejects>=p, accepts zero; first accepted value x0, then1048576 RHS in order; each size uses actual prefix
corpus.hash_recipe: FNV1a64 unsigned wrap; FE64 hash=x0BE32 then RHS BE32; resident hash=x0BE32 then each RHS five raw limbs, each word BE8; prefix hashes use same initial x0
